title.en: Receiving DSB-SC: envelope, filter and drift
title.or: DSB-SC ଗ୍ରହଣ: Envelope, Filter ଓ Drift

framing.en: A 100 kHz DSB-SC signal carries a 1 kHz tone. We'll find its spectrum, see why a cheap envelope detector fails, then watch what a 50 Hz oscillator drift does.
framing.or: ଏକ 100 kHz DSB-SC signal ଗୋଟିଏ 1 kHz tone ବହନ କରେ। ଏହାର Spectrum ବାହାର କରିବା, ଶସ୍ତା Envelope detector କାହିଁକି ବିଫଳ ହୁଏ ଦେଖିବା, ତାପରେ 50 Hz Oscillator drift ର ପ୍ରଭାବ ଦେଖିବା।

misconceptions.desc: Believes a DSB-SC spectrum still has a line at the carrier frequency, as conventional AM does.
An envelope detector works equally well on DSB-SC (ledger M-AM-03).
Believes adding any carrier, however small, makes envelope detection work; ignores overmodulation (μ > 1).
Believes a local-oscillator frequency offset only shifts the recovered tone by Δf (SSB behaviour), with no beating or fading.
The receiver can use an arbitrary (or merely close) carrier frequency or phase (ledger M-AM-06).

text.en: A DSB-SC signal s(t) = 2cos(2π·10³t)·cos(2π·10⁵t) V arrives at a receiver. (a) Which frequencies does it contain, and what bandwidth? (b) What does an envelope detector give, and what is the smallest carrier A·cos(2π·10⁵t) to add so that one works? (c) Where should a coherent receiver's lowpass cutoff go? (d) If the local oscillator drifts to 100.05 kHz, what comes out and how often does it fade to zero?
text.or: ଏକ DSB-SC signal s(t) = 2cos(2π·10³t)·cos(2π·10⁵t) V Receiver ରେ ପହଞ୍ଚେ। (a) ଏଥିରେ କେଉଁ Frequency ଅଛି, Bandwidth କେତେ? (b) Envelope detector କଣ ଦିଏ, ଏବଂ ଏହା କାମ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ କେତେ Carrier A·cos(2π·10⁵t) ଯୋଡ଼ିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ? (c) Coherent receiver ର Lowpass cutoff କେଉଁଠି ରଖିବେ? (d) Local oscillator 100.05 kHz କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚିଗଲେ Output କଣ ହୁଏ, ଏବଂ ଏହା କେତେ ଥର ଶୂନ୍ୟ ହୁଏ?

given.en: Message m(t) = 2cos(2π·10³t) V (a 1 kHz tone); carrier frequency fc = 100 kHz.
given.or: Message m(t) = 2cos(2π·10³t) V (1 kHz tone); Carrier frequency fc = 100 kHz।

given.en: Coherent receiver: product with a unit-amplitude local oscillator, ideal lowpass filter, then gain 2.
given.or: Coherent receiver: unit-amplitude Local oscillator ସହ Product, ideal Lowpass filter, ତାପରେ Gain 2।

given.en: Powers are normalised to a 1 Ω load.

text.en: Product to sum: cos A · cos B = ½[cos(A−B) + cos(A+B)].
text.or: Product ରୁ Sum: cos A · cos B = ½[cos(A−B) + cos(A+B)]।

note.en: Two sidebands of 1 V each; no term at 100 kHz.

caption.en: Spectrum of s(t): two sidebands, no carrier line
caption.or: s(t) ର Spectrum: ଦୁଇଟି Sideband, Carrier line ନାହିଁ

text.en: Lines at 99 and 101 kHz (1 V each), nothing at 100 kHz; bandwidth 2 kHz.
text.or: 99 ଓ 101 kHz ରେ Line (ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ 1 V), 100 kHz ରେ କିଛି ନାହିଁ; Bandwidth 2 kHz।

caption.en: DSB-SC wave with ±m(t) traced (carrier drawn at 12× the tone, not 100×, for clarity)

note.en: The detector follows the peaks, so the sign of m(t) is lost at every zero crossing.

text.en: |m(t)| holds 4/π ≈ 1.27 V of DC, 0.85 V at 2 kHz, 0.17 V at 4 kHz … and nothing at 1 kHz: the tone itself is gone.
text.or: |m(t)| ରେ 4/π ≈ 1.27 V DC, 2 kHz ରେ 0.85 V, 4 kHz ରେ 0.17 V … ଅଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ 1 kHz ରେ କିଛି ନାହିଁ।

note.en: Adding a carrier turns DSB-SC into conventional AM.
For μ ≤ 1 the bracket never goes negative, so the envelope equals A + m(t).

text.en: Smallest added carrier: 2 V, giving 100% modulation.
text.or: ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ Carrier: 2 V, ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ 100% Modulation।

text.en: Price of the cheap detector: carrier power A²/2 = 2 W against 1 W in the sidebands, so efficiency η = 1/3 at best (μ²/(2+μ²) at μ = 1).
text.or: ଶସ୍ତା Detector ର ମୂଲ୍ୟ: Carrier power 2 W, Sideband ରେ 1 W, ତେଣୁ Efficiency ସର୍ବାଧିକ 1/3।

note.en: With a matched oscillator: the message at 1 kHz plus copies near 2fc = 200 kHz.

caption.en: Multiplier output v(t) with a matched oscillator
caption.or: Matched oscillator ସହ Multiplier output v(t)

text.en: Cutoff above the message and well below 2fc; gain 2 then returns exactly m(t).
text.or: Cutoff Message ଠାରୁ ଉପରେ ଓ 2fc ଠାରୁ ବହୁତ ତଳେ; Gain 2 ପରେ ଠିକ୍ m(t) ମିଳେ।

note.en: The 2fc terms (199.05 and 201.05 kHz) are filtered out.
Each sideband lands 50 Hz off, in opposite directions.

caption.en: Output with a 50 Hz drift: two tones, not one
caption.or: 50 Hz drift ସହ Output: ଗୋଟିଏ ନୁହେଁ, ଦୁଇଟି Tone

caption.en: Recovered output beating: it fades to zero at 5 ms and 15 ms
caption.or: Output ର Beating: 5 ms ଓ 15 ms ରେ ଶୂନ୍ୟ

text.en: The output dies 100 times a second (at 5 ms, 15 ms, 25 ms …).
text.or: Output ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ 100 ଥର ଶୂନ୍ୟ ହୁଏ।

text.en: Contrast: with only the upper sideband (SSB), the same +50 Hz drift just moves the tone to 950 Hz, a pitch shift with no fading. DSB-SC has two sidebands that move apart.
text.or: ତୁଳନା: କେବଳ Upper sideband (SSB) ଥିଲେ ସେହି 50 Hz drift Tone କୁ 950 Hz କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଏ, Fading ନାହିଁ।

text.en: DSB-SC needs a locked local oscillator: a drift Δf splits the message into two tones Δf either side, which beat and fade 2Δf times a second.
text.or: DSB-SC ପାଇଁ Locked local oscillator ଦରକାର: Δf drift Message କୁ ଦୁଇଟି Tone ରେ ଭାଗ କରେ, ଯାହା Beat କରି ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ 2Δf ଥର Fade ହୁଏ।

say.en: First, the transmitted spectrum.
say.or: ପ୍ରଥମେ, ପଠାଯାଉଥିବା Spectrum।

p-spectrum.goal: Student finds the two sideband lines (99 and 101 kHz, 1 V each), notes there is no line at 100 kHz, and gives bandwidth 2 kHz.

say.en: s(t) is a 1 kHz tone times a 100 kHz carrier. Which frequencies are actually in it, and how wide is it?
say.or: s(t) ହେଉଛି 1 kHz tone × 100 kHz Carrier। ଏଥିରେ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ କେଉଁ Frequency ଅଛି, ଏବଂ ଏହା କେତେ ଚଉଡ଼ା?

expect.desc: Lines at fc − fm and fc + fm (99 and 101 kHz), no carrier line at 100 kHz, bandwidth 2 kHz (2fm). Saying 'two sidebands around 100 kHz, 2 kHz wide' counts.

ack.en: Yes: two sidebands, 2 kHz wide, and nothing at 100 kHz.
ack.or: ହଁ: ଦୁଇଟି Sideband, 2 kHz ଚଉଡ଼ା, 100 kHz ରେ କିଛି ନାହିଁ।

expect.desc: Gets the sideband frequencies (99 and 101 kHz) but gives the bandwidth as 1 kHz (fm) or omits it.

ack.en: The two lines are right. Now measure from one to the other.
ack.or: Line ଦୁଇଟି ଠିକ୍। ଏବେ ଗୋଟିଏରୁ ଅନ୍ୟଟି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ମାପନ୍ତୁ।

misconceptions.desc: Includes a component at the carrier frequency 100 kHz (three lines: 99, 100, 101 kHz), as in conventional AM.

ack.en: Not yet. That third line belongs to conventional AM; let's check this product.
ack.or: ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ। ସେହି ତୃତୀୟ Line Conventional AM ର; ଏହି Product କୁ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବା।

say.en: If you multiply two cosines, what do you get?
say.or: ଦୁଇଟି Cosine କୁ ଗୁଣନ କଲେ କଣ ମିଳେ?

say.en: A product of cosines splits into a difference frequency and a sum frequency.
say.or: Cosine ର Product ଏକ Difference frequency ଓ ଏକ Sum frequency ରେ ଭାଙ୍ଗେ।

say.en: Use the identity on the board with A at 100 kHz and B at 1 kHz.
say.or: Board ରେ ଥିବା Identity ରେ A = 100 kHz ଓ B = 1 kHz ନିଅନ୍ତୁ।

say.en: Two lines, at 99 and 101 kHz, 1 V each, and none at 100 kHz. The bandwidth is 101 − 99 = 2 kHz.
say.or: ଦୁଇଟି Line, 99 ଓ 101 kHz ରେ, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ 1 V, 100 kHz ରେ କିଛି ନାହିଁ। Bandwidth 101 − 99 = 2 kHz।

chips.text: Two lines at 99 kHz and 101 kHz, so the bandwidth is 2 kHz.
Three lines: 99, 100 and 101 kHz.
I am not sure.

show-bw.goal: Bandwidth is the span between the outer lines: 101 − 99 = 2 kHz = 2fm, not fm.

say.en: Bandwidth is the width the signal occupies, from 99 to 101 kHz. That is 2 kHz, twice the tone.
say.or: Bandwidth ହେଉଛି Signal ଅଧିକାର କରୁଥିବା ଚଉଡ଼ା, 99 ରୁ 101 kHz। ତାହା 2 kHz, Tone ର ଦୁଇଗୁଣ।

show-no-carrier.goal: Expand the product: only difference and sum terms appear; no term at fc because m(t) has no DC.

say.en: Expand the product and only 99 and 101 kHz appear. A 100 kHz line needs a DC part in m(t), and this tone has none.
say.or: Product ଖୋଲିଲେ କେବଳ 99 ଓ 101 kHz ଆସେ। 100 kHz line ପାଇଁ m(t) ରେ DC ଦରକାର, ଏହି Tone ରେ ତାହା ନାହିଁ।

say.en: An envelope detector is cheap: a diode and a capacitor. Here is the wave it would see.
say.or: Envelope detector ଶସ୍ତା: ଗୋଟିଏ Diode ଓ ଗୋଟିଏ Capacitor। ଏହା ଦେଖିବା Wave ଏଠାରେ।

p-envelope.goal: Student says the detector follows the peaks, giving |m(t)|: the sign flips of m(t) are lost, so the output is a rectified wave, not the 1 kHz tone.

say.en: An envelope detector traces the positive peaks. What would it hand you for this wave?
say.or: Envelope detector Positive peak ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରେ। ଏହି Wave ପାଇଁ ଏହା କଣ ଦେବ?

expect.desc: Output is |m(t)| (a rectified, always-positive version of the tone): the detector cannot see the sign/phase reversals at zero crossings, so the message is distorted (doubled frequency).

ack.en: Right: it gives |m(t)|, and the sign is gone.

misconceptions.desc: Says the envelope detector recovers m(t), the 1 kHz tone, just as it would for AM.

ack.en: Not yet. Follow the top edge of the wave across a zero crossing.
ack.or: ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ। Zero crossing ପାର ହେବା ସମୟରେ Wave ର ଉପର ଧାର ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ।

say.en: Look where m(t) crosses zero. What happens to the top edge of s(t) there?
say.or: m(t) ଯେଉଁଠି ଶୂନ୍ୟ ପାର କରେ, ସେଠାରେ s(t) ର ଉପର ଧାର କଣ ହୁଏ?

say.en: The top edge follows +m(t) while m(t) is positive. When m(t) goes negative, which trace is on top?
say.or: m(t) Positive ଥିବା ବେଳେ ଉପର ଧାର +m(t) ଅନୁସରଣ କରେ। m(t) Negative ହେଲେ କେଉଁ Trace ଉପରେ ଥାଏ?

say.en: Where m(t) is negative, −m(t) is the upper trace, so the peaks always follow the positive one.
say.or: m(t) Negative ଥିବା ଜାଗାରେ −m(t) ଉପରେ ଥାଏ, ତେଣୁ Peak ସବୁବେଳେ Positive ଟିକୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରେ।

say.en: It gives |m(t)| = 2|cos(2π·10³t)|, a rectified wave. It has no 1 kHz part at all.
say.or: ଏହା |m(t)| = 2|cos(2π·10³t)| ଦିଏ। ଏଥିରେ 1 kHz ଅଂଶ ଆଦୌ ନାହିଁ।

chips.text: It gives back the 1 kHz message.
It gives the magnitude of m(t), so the sign is lost.
I am not sure.

show-env-fails.goal: Counter M-AM-03: the DSB-SC envelope is |m(t)|; its spectrum has DC and 2 kHz but no 1 kHz, so the detector cannot return the tone.

say.en: Past each zero crossing the lower trace becomes the top, so the peaks give |m(t)|. That wave has no 1 kHz in it.
say.or: ପ୍ରତି Zero crossing ପରେ ତଳ Trace ଉପରକୁ ଆସେ, ତେଣୁ Peak ଗୁଡ଼ିକ |m(t)| ଦିଏ। ସେଥିରେ 1 kHz ନାହିଁ।

p-carrier.goal: Student writes μ = 2/A and requires μ ≤ 1, giving the smallest added carrier A = 2 V.

say.en: Fix: add a carrier A·cos(2π·10⁵t). What is the smallest A that lets the envelope detector work?
say.or: ସମାଧାନ: ଏକ Carrier A·cos(2π·10⁵t) ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ। Envelope detector କାମ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଛୋଟ A କେତେ?

expect.desc: A = 2 V (or A ≥ 2 V): μ = peak of m(t)/A = 2/A must be ≤ 1 so A + m(t) never goes negative.
Gives A = 1 V or similar, treating μ as the message peak or ignoring that the tone's peak is 2 V.

ack.en: Not yet. Check the message peak against A.
ack.or: ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ। Message peak କୁ A ସହ ତୁଳନା କରନ୍ତୁ।

misconceptions.desc: Says any carrier, however small, makes envelope detection work (ignores overmodulation, μ > 1).

ack.en: Not yet. A small carrier still lets the bracket go negative.
ack.or: ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ। ଛୋଟ Carrier ରେ Bracket ଏବେ ବି Negative ହୁଏ।

say.en: The envelope is A + m(t). When could it go negative?
say.or: Envelope ହେଉଛି A + m(t)। ଏହା କେବେ Negative ହୋଇପାରେ?

say.en: Read μ off the bracket on the board. μ must not exceed one.
say.or: Board ର Bracket ରୁ μ ପଢ଼ନ୍ତୁ। μ ଏକରୁ ଅଧିକ ହେବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।

say.en: The bracket is 1 + (2/A)cos(…), so μ = 2/A.
say.or: Bracket ହେଉଛି 1 + (2/A)cos(…), ତେଣୁ μ = 2/A।

say.en: 2/A ≤ 1, so A must be at least 2 V. At 2 V the modulation is exactly 100%.
say.or: 2/A ≤ 1, ତେଣୁ A ଅତି କମରେ 2 V। 2 V ରେ Modulation ଠିକ୍ 100%।

chips.text: A has to be 2 V, so that mu is 1.
A of 1 V is enough.
Any small carrier is enough, it just has to be there.
I am not sure.

show-mu-def.goal: μ compares the message peak (2 V) with A; with A = 1 V, μ = 2 and the detector distorts.

say.en: The message peak is 2 V, so μ = 2/A. With A = 1 V, μ would be 2: overmodulated.
say.or: Message peak 2 V, ତେଣୁ μ = 2/A। A = 1 V ରେ μ = 2: Overmodulation।

show-overmod.goal: Counter any-carrier-enough: for μ > 1 the bracket A + m(t) goes negative, the envelope is |A + m(t)| and the detector distorts.

say.en: With a small A, A + m(t) still dips below zero, and the detector sees its magnitude again. So we need A ≥ 2 V.
say.or: ଛୋଟ A ରେ A + m(t) ଶୂନ୍ୟ ତଳକୁ ଯାଏ, Detector ପୁଣି Magnitude ଦେଖେ। ତେଣୁ A ≥ 2 V ଦରକାର।

show-efficiency.goal: Show the cost: at A = 2 V the carrier takes 2 W against 1 W of sidebands, η = 1/3.

say.en: That carrier costs power: 2 W of carrier for 1 W of sidebands. Efficiency is only one third.
say.or: ସେହି Carrier ପାଇଁ Power ଲାଗେ: 1 W Sideband ପାଇଁ 2 W Carrier। Efficiency କେବଳ ଏକ-ତୃତୀୟାଂଶ।

say.en: Instead, keep DSB-SC and use a product receiver with a matched local oscillator.
say.or: ବଦଳରେ, DSB-SC ରଖି ମେଳ ଥିବା Local oscillator ସହ Product receiver ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

p-lpf.goal: Student finds the multiplier output (1 kHz message plus terms near 2fc: 199 and 201 kHz) and puts the cutoff between them, e.g. 5 kHz.

say.en: After the product, what frequencies are in v(t), and where should the lowpass cutoff go?
say.or: Product ପରେ v(t) ରେ କେଉଁ Frequency ଅଛି, ଏବଂ Lowpass cutoff କେଉଁଠି ରଖିବେ?

expect.desc: Message at 1 kHz plus components near 2fc (199 and 201 kHz); cutoff above 1 kHz and well below 199 kHz (any value such as 2, 5, 10 or 50 kHz).

ack.en: Yes: keep 1 kHz, block the 200 kHz pair.
ack.or: ହଁ: 1 kHz ରଖନ୍ତୁ, 200 kHz ପାଖର ଯୋଡ଼ିକୁ ରୋକନ୍ତୁ।

expect.desc: Puts the cutoff at or below the 1 kHz message (e.g. 500 Hz or 1 kHz exactly), or says filter out the 1 kHz part.

ack.en: Not yet. Which line is the message you want to keep?
ack.or: ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ। ରଖିବାକୁ ଥିବା Message କେଉଁ Line?

say.en: Multiply the two sidebands by the 100 kHz oscillator. Where do the new terms land?
say.or: ଦୁଇଟି Sideband କୁ 100 kHz Oscillator ସହ ଗୁଣନ କରନ୍ତୁ। ନୂଆ Term କେଉଁଠି ପଡ଼େ?

say.en: Each product gives a difference and a sum. The differences sit near zero, the sums near twice the carrier.
say.or: ପ୍ରତି Product ଏକ Difference ଓ ଏକ Sum ଦିଏ। Difference ଶୂନ୍ୟ ପାଖରେ, Sum Carrier ର ଦୁଇଗୁଣ ପାଖରେ।

say.en: The differences add up to the 1 kHz tone. Now pick a cutoff that keeps it and blocks the rest.
say.or: Difference ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମିଶି 1 kHz tone ହୁଏ। ଏହାକୁ ରଖି ବାକି ରୋକୁଥିବା Cutoff ବାଛନ୍ତୁ।

say.en: v(t) has 1 kHz plus 199 and 201 kHz. Any cutoff between them works, say 5 kHz, and gain 2 gives back m(t).
say.or: v(t) ରେ 1 kHz ସହ 199 ଓ 201 kHz ଅଛି। ମଝିରେ ଯେକୌଣସି Cutoff, ଯେପରି 5 kHz, ଚଳିବ, ଏବଂ Gain 2 ପରେ m(t) ମିଳେ।

chips.text: Keep 1 kHz and remove 199 and 201 kHz, so a cutoff around 5 kHz.
Cut off at 500 Hz to be safe.
I am not sure.

show-too-low.goal: A cutoff at or below 1 kHz removes or attenuates the message itself; the cutoff must sit above the message and below 2fc.

say.en: The message is the 1 kHz line, so a 500 Hz cutoff throws it away. The cutoff must sit above 1 kHz.
say.or: Message ହେଉଛି 1 kHz line, 500 Hz cutoff ତାକୁ ହଟାଇଦିଏ। Cutoff 1 kHz ଉପରେ ରହିବା ଦରକାର।

show-gain.goal: The filtered 1 kHz term is cos(2π·10³t), half of m(t); gain 2 restores m(t) exactly with a matched oscillator.

say.en: After the filter you have cos(2π·10³t), half of m(t). Gain 2 brings back the full 2 V tone.
say.or: Filter ପରେ cos(2π·10³t) ମିଳେ, m(t) ର ଅଧା। Gain 2 ପୂରା 2 V tone ଫେରାଇ ଆଣେ।

say.en: Now the local oscillator drifts to 100.05 kHz, just 50 Hz off.
say.or: ଏବେ Local oscillator 100.05 kHz କୁ ଘୁଞ୍ଚିଯାଏ, କେବଳ 50 Hz ତଫାତ।

p-freq.goal: Student finds y(t) = m(t)cos(2π·50t) = cos(2π·950t) + cos(2π·1050t): two tones, a 1 kHz tone whose amplitude swells and dies at the offset rate.

say.en: Same receiver, oscillator 50 Hz high. What comes out of the gain stage now?
say.or: ସେହି Receiver, Oscillator 50 Hz ଉପରେ। ଏବେ Gain stage ରୁ କଣ ବାହାରେ?

expect.desc: y(t) = m(t)cos(2π·50t), i.e. two tones at 950 Hz and 1050 Hz (1 V each); equivalently a 1 kHz tone whose amplitude is multiplied by cos(2π·50t).

ack.en: Exactly: the tone times cos(2π·50t), two lines at 950 and 1050 Hz.
ack.or: ଠିକ୍: Tone × cos(2π·50t), 950 ଓ 1050 Hz ରେ ଦୁଇଟି Line।

expect.desc: Says the output is the tone but its loudness/amplitude rises and falls slowly (wobbles, fades), without the 950/1050 Hz or m(t)cos(2π·50t) form.

ack.en: Good instinct. Here is the exact form behind that wobble.
ack.or: ଭଲ ଅନୁମାନ। ସେହି Wobble ର ସଠିକ୍ ରୂପ ଏଠାରେ।

misconceptions.desc: Says the recovered tone is simply shifted by 50 Hz, to one frequency (1050 Hz or 950 Hz), with steady amplitude.

ack.en: Not yet. There are two sidebands; follow each one.
ack.or: ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ। ଦୁଇଟି Sideband ଅଛି; ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକକୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରନ୍ତୁ।

misconceptions.desc: Says a 50 Hz offset is negligible (0.05% of the carrier) and the output is still essentially m(t), or that the filter/gain removes the error.

ack.en: Not yet. 50 Hz is tiny next to 100 kHz, but not next to the message.
ack.or: ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ। 100 kHz ତୁଳନାରେ 50 Hz ଛୋଟ, କିନ୍ତୁ Message ତୁଳନାରେ ନୁହେଁ।

say.en: Redo the product with cos(2π·100050t). What is the difference frequency for each sideband?
say.or: cos(2π·100050t) ସହ Product ପୁଣି କରନ୍ତୁ। ପ୍ରତି Sideband ର Difference frequency କେତେ?

say.en: The upper sideband is at 101 kHz and the lower at 99 kHz. Subtract 100.05 kHz from each, ignoring sign.
say.or: Upper sideband 101 kHz, Lower 99 kHz। ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକରୁ 100.05 kHz ବିୟୋଗ କରନ୍ତୁ, Sign ଛାଡ଼ି।

say.en: In general the output is m(t) times cos(2πΔf t). Put Δf in.
say.or: ସାଧାରଣତଃ Output = m(t) × cos(2πΔf t)। Δf ବସାନ୍ତୁ।

say.en: y(t) = m(t)cos(2π·50t) = cos(2π·950t) + cos(2π·1050t). Two tones, not one.
say.or: y(t) = m(t)cos(2π·50t) = cos(2π·950t) + cos(2π·1050t)। ଗୋଟିଏ ନୁହେଁ, ଦୁଇଟି Tone।

chips.text: Two tones, at 950 Hz and 1050 Hz.
The tone just shifts up to 1050 Hz.
50 Hz is tiny, so it is still m(t).
I am not sure.

show-both-sidebands.goal: Counter offset-shifts-tone: the USB lands at 950 Hz and the LSB at 1050 Hz; a single shifted tone is what SSB would give.

say.en: The upper sideband lands at 950 Hz and the lower at 1050 Hz, so both tones come out. A single shifted tone is what SSB would give.
say.or: Upper sideband 950 Hz ରେ ଓ Lower 1050 Hz ରେ ପଡ଼େ, ତେଣୁ ଦୁଇଟି Tone ବାହାରେ। ଗୋଟିଏ ଘୁଞ୍ଚିଥିବା Tone SSB ରେ ମିଳନ୍ତା।

show-drift-matters.goal: Counter M-AM-06: what matters is Δf relative to the message, not to the carrier; cos(2π·50t) multiplies the output.

say.en: The error rides on the output as cos(2π·50t), and 50 Hz is comparable to the 1 kHz tone. No filter after the product can remove it.
say.or: Error ଟି Output ରେ cos(2π·50t) ଭାବେ ରହେ, ଏବଂ 50 Hz, 1 kHz tone ସହ ତୁଳନୀୟ। Product ପରର କୌଣସି Filter ଏହାକୁ ହଟାଇ ପାରିବ ନାହିଁ।

p-fade.goal: Student sees |cos(2π·50t)| hits zero twice per 20 ms cycle, so the output fades out 100 times a second (every 10 ms).

say.en: The output is the tone times cos(2π·50t). How many times a second does it fade to nothing?
say.or: Output ହେଉଛି Tone × cos(2π·50t)। ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ ଏହା କେତେ ଥର ଶୂନ୍ୟ ହୁଏ?

expect.desc: 100 times per second (every 10 ms), because cos(2π·50t) passes through zero twice per 20 ms period; 2Δf counts.

ack.en: Yes: 100 fades a second, one every 10 ms.
ack.or: ହଁ: ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ 100 ଥର, ପ୍ରତି 10 ms ରେ ଥରେ।

expect.desc: Says 50 times per second (every 20 ms), taking the 50 Hz cosine frequency as the fade rate.

ack.en: Close. Count the zeros in one 20 ms cycle of the cosine.
ack.or: ପାଖାପାଖି। Cosine ର ଗୋଟିଏ 20 ms Cycle ରେ Zero ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

misconceptions.desc: Says it never fades: the output is a steady tone at a shifted frequency.

ack.en: Not yet. Two close tones cannot stay steady together.
ack.or: ଏବେ ନୁହେଁ। ପାଖାପାଖି ଦୁଇଟି Tone ମିଶି ସ୍ଥିର ରହେ ନାହିଁ।

say.en: When is cos(2π·50t) equal to zero?
say.or: cos(2π·50t) କେବେ ଶୂନ୍ୟ ହୁଏ?

say.en: One cycle of a 50 Hz cosine lasts 20 ms. How many zero crossings fit in one cycle?
say.or: 50 Hz Cosine ର ଗୋଟିଏ Cycle 20 ms। ଗୋଟିଏ Cycle ରେ କେତୋଟି Zero crossing?

say.en: A cosine crosses zero twice per cycle, so count crossings over fifty cycles.
say.or: Cosine ପ୍ରତି Cycle ରେ ଦୁଇଥର ଶୂନ୍ୟ ପାର କରେ, ତେଣୁ ପଚାଶ Cycle ରେ ଗଣନ୍ତୁ।

say.en: Twice per 20 ms cycle, so 100 fades a second, at 5 ms, 15 ms, 25 ms and so on.
say.or: ପ୍ରତି 20 ms ରେ ଦୁଇଥର, ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ 100 ଥର: 5 ms, 15 ms, 25 ms…

chips.text: 100 times a second, every 10 ms.
50 times a second, since the offset is 50 Hz.
It never fades; it is a steady shifted tone.
I am not sure.

show-null-count.goal: cos(2π·50t) has two zeros per 20 ms period, so the envelope |2cos(2π·50t)| nulls 2Δf = 100 times a second.

say.en: The envelope is |2cos(2π·50t)|, and it hits zero twice in each 20 ms cycle. So the fades come every 10 ms.
say.or: Envelope ହେଉଛି |2cos(2π·50t)|, ପ୍ରତି 20 ms Cycle ରେ ଦୁଇଥର ଶୂନ୍ୟ। ତେଣୁ ପ୍ରତି 10 ms ରେ Fade।

show-fades.goal: Counter offset-shifts-tone: 950 and 1050 Hz beat; the waveform shows nulls at 5 ms and 15 ms.

say.en: Look at the trace: the 950 and 1050 Hz tones cancel at 5 ms and 15 ms. That is beating, not a steady tone.
say.or: Trace ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ: 950 ଓ 1050 Hz tone 5 ms ଓ 15 ms ରେ ପରସ୍ପରକୁ କାଟନ୍ତି। ଏହା Beating, ସ୍ଥିର Tone ନୁହେଁ।

say.en: Last step: put the whole story in your own words.
say.or: ଶେଷ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ: ପୂରା କଥାଟି ନିଜ ଭାଷାରେ କୁହନ୍ତୁ।

p-explain.goal: Student explains in English that the drift moves the two sidebands to Δf either side of the tone, and the two beat, so DSB-SC needs a frequency-locked local oscillator.

say.en: In one or two English sentences: why does a tiny oscillator drift ruin DSB-SC reception?
say.or: ଏକ ବା ଦୁଇଟି ଇଂରାଜୀ ବାକ୍ୟରେ: ଛୋଟ Oscillator drift DSB-SC reception କୁ କାହିଁକି ନଷ୍ଟ କରେ?

expect.desc: Explains the mechanism: the frequency mismatch moves the two sidebands to two different output frequencies (fm ± Δf) and they beat, so the output fades at 2Δf; the oscillator must be locked to the carrier.
Says the oscillator must match or the output is distorted, without saying why (no two sidebands, no beating or fading).

ack.en: True. Add the why: what happens to the two sidebands?
ack.or: ଠିକ୍। କାହିଁକି ଯୋଡ଼ନ୍ତୁ: ଦୁଇଟି Sideband ର କଣ ହୁଏ?

say.en: What happens to each sideband when the oscillator is off by Δf?
say.or: Oscillator Δf ତଫାତ ହେଲେ ପ୍ରତି Sideband ର କଣ ହୁଏ?

say.en: Use the words sideband, frequency mismatch and beating.
say.or: Sideband, Frequency mismatch ଓ Beating ଶବ୍ଦ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତୁ।

say.en: Start with: 'The frequency mismatch moves the two sidebands…'
say.or: ଏହିପରି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତୁ: 'The frequency mismatch moves the two sidebands…'

say.en: The frequency mismatch moves the two sidebands to fm − Δf and fm + Δf. They beat, so the output fades 2Δf times a second; the oscillator must be locked.
say.or: Frequency mismatch ଦୁଇଟି Sideband କୁ fm − Δf ଓ fm + Δf କୁ ନିଏ। ସେମାନେ Beat କରନ୍ତି, Output ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ 2Δf ଥର Fade ହୁଏ।

chips.text: The mismatch moves the two sidebands to different frequencies, so they beat and the output fades.
The oscillator must match, otherwise there is distortion.
I am not sure.

conclusion.goal: Wrap up: DSB-SC saves carrier power but needs a coherent, locked receiver; envelope detection needs μ ≤ 1 carrier; drift causes beating at 2Δf.

say.en: DSB-SC saves the carrier's power, but the receiver must then supply a locked carrier. Otherwise, add 2 V of carrier and pay for it in efficiency.
say.or: DSB-SC Carrier power ବଞ୍ଚାଏ, କିନ୍ତୁ Receiver କୁ Locked carrier ଦେବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ। ନଚେତ୍ 2 V Carrier ଯୋଡ଼ି Efficiency ରେ ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ।

why.en: Try fault F-AM-FREQ in the DSB-SC lab: a 2010 Hz local carrier against 2000 Hz should fade 20 times a second.
why.or: DSB-SC lab ରେ F-AM-FREQ fault ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତୁ: 2000 Hz ବଦଳରେ 2010 Hz local carrier ପ୍ରତି ସେକେଣ୍ଡରେ 20 ଥର Fade ହେବା ଉଚିତ।

why.en: Revisit carrier mismatch: m(t)cos(2πΔf t + φ).
Revisit DSB-SC sidebands and why there is no carrier line.
Revisit the AM envelope and the μ ≤ 1 condition.
Revisit why envelope detection needs a retained carrier.
Revisit choosing a lowpass cutoff between the message and 2fc.
Next, the phase-error twin: matched frequency, 60° and 90° phase.
